header.label: ACCENTURE & AVANADE COMMUNITY
header.tagline:
Built around one valuable skill: Claude Code.
Asia, Europe, Oceania — and now the Americas, with our first member from Argentina! Come join us and help grow the Americas side.🔥

quotes.text: Connecting with likeminded people and share thoughts around AI and increasing productivity

activities.title: Learn & Build Sessions
activities.body:
First half: presentation & discussion.
Second half: hands-on build related to the first half.
No need to attend every time.

activities.title: Build Hour
activities.body: Build on any theme you like — yours or a suggested one. Ask questions, trade ideas, then demo the outputs to each other.

activities.title: “Tips Exchange” Pair
steps: Get paired with one member, usually from another region.
Each share one tip — a few lines or a screenshot is fine.
Try your partner’s tip, then reply.

activities.title: Questions answered in chat
activities.body: Ask in the *#03_Ask for help* channel, whenever you have questions or problem.

activities.title: Casual Interaction Events
activities.body: Welcome events for new members, and casual events in between.

activities.title: Cross-Border Project Work using Claude Code

note.title: Until the Americas sessions start
items:
Join the **Asia · Europe · Oceania** sessions if the time works:
- **Learn & Build Sessions** → every other Sunday, 11:00 UTC
- **Build Hour** → weekdays (time varies)

These work at any time:
- **Tips Exchange** → get paired with a member
- *#03_Ask for help* → ask anything
Tell us the days and times that suit you, so we can set up the **Americas sessions** as soon as possible.
